batches.why: Required and optional slots: a character without art for dance, sing, eat or think no longer does them, so its picks draw from a shorter table. Every trace here has at least one such buddy. The rest still come from the original engine.

A floor behaviour named directly in the air (happy, stand, sprawl) left a buddy hanging for good: only air falls, and nothing brought her down. She now lands first, then does it. Each of these recorded the hang, about 12,000 frames of it, so they are also shorter: settle no longer waits out its limit on a buddy who can't land.

Engine fixes from an artist's notes. Two of them move traces, and nothing else in these traces changes: frames, random draws, states and positions all match. A ceiling leap is no longer a throw: ceilGo set P.thrown so she could catch the ceiling, and now sets its own flag, so P.thrown reads false through the leap. 39 traces move there and only there, 6,451 pet frames, all in the air, thrown going from true to false. No buddy here has Thrown art, so nothing drawn changes. The swing's lean now follows her held art, not the frame's pose: with any of Held, swung left or swung right drawn it is a quarter of the swing all the way. The mixed buddy has only swung-left art, so she now leans a quarter where she leaned the whole swing, and stops jumping from one to the other at plus or minus 10. 12 traces move in that turn alone, 1,248 frames; resize-mixed is in both. Plain and full buddies lean as before.

Transitions from an artist's notes. One of the four moves traces: a timed state whose time runs out now lets her own art for the pose finish the pass it is in, at most one pass, when that art has more than one frame. With that change switched off, all 134 traces match as recorded, and in each of these 78 the first frame that differs is the first frame a timed state waits for its pass. No trace waits that isn't here. The full buddy draws 26 poses with one to four frames each, and the mixed buddy draws a three-frame walk and a two-frame hang, so their traces move; the plain buddy has no art and none of its traces move. 16,137 pet frames wait in all, most of them walking (6,357), then holding a wall, sitting, hanging, climbing and crawling. Everything after a wait follows from it: what comes next starts later and draws its random numbers later. The other three changes, a Roll pose, a stand up for each way down and the clips into Sit and Sleep, need art no golden buddy has, so they move nothing.
